kitEvidence.formula:
Zac stretches his arm out, attaching it to the first enemy hit to deal [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.3) × AP + (0.03) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] magic damage and briefly Slow them. Zac's next Attack gains increased range and applies the same damage and Slow. 

If Zac hits a different enemy with this Attack, he Knocks Up both towards each other. If they collide, they and surrounding enemies take [60 / 90 / 120 / 150 / 180 + (0.3) × AP + (0.03) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] magic damage and are briefly Slowed.
